help_text.cluster: The cluster or sub-region the country belongs to (e.g. Mid-Size Markets, South East Asia). Filled automatically when you pick a country.
help_text.products: The product(s) or therapeutic area the interaction was about. Pick 'General' if it covered several TAs.
help_text.stakeholders: The J&J function(s) you interacted with, e.g. MAF (Medical Affairs), Reg. (Regulatory). Several can be selected.
help_text.activity_type: Discussion = conversation/meeting; Presentation = you presented; Material = you shared a document.
help_text.content: The type of safety content covered. Several can be selected.
help_text.materials: The Local Medical Safety material(s) you used, from the LMS materials list.
help_text.comments: Describe the interaction: what was provided, who was involved, and why the interaction occurred.
help_text.feedback: Any feedback received and/or information related to potential interaction impact.
help_text.specific_icsr: Which ICSR / AE / safety signal the interaction is related to, if any.
help_text.stakeholder_status: New = first interaction with this stakeholder; Established = ongoing relationship.
help_text.impact_category: The main value this interaction delivered (demo list, pending the final KPI set).
